channel.title: Pier & Point · Terry A Francois Boulevard paseo
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Terry A Francois Boulevard paseo (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Terry A Francois Boulevard paseo: The Mission Rock Design Controls list the open…
item.description: The Mission Rock Design Controls list the open space as "Section 4.3 Paseo: Terry Francois Boulevard" and describe it in section 4.3.4: "Between Block K and Pier 48, Terry A Francois Boulevard will become a paseo". The new name follows that wording and the other two Mission Rock paseo records; where the paseo is (the Pier 48 end of the boulevard) stays in the record's text. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Design Controls, April 24, 2018 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf), Figure 3.1.1, p.45: "Section 4.3 Paseo: Terry Francois Boulevard"; section 4.3.4, p.90: "PASEO NORTH OF EXPOSITION STREET Between Block K and Pier 48, Terry A Francois Boulevard will become a paseo that will accommodate emergency vehicle access for up to 150' of its length".

item.title: Correction · Terry A Francois Boulevard paseo: The paseo page now says that the lot numbers for…
item.description: The paseo page now says that the lot numbers for the two Phase 1 paseos are matched by position and address, not named by any Port document, and that its south edge uses the Exposition Street lot 8719A010, which carries a recorded drop date of March 18, 2025 in the Assessor data while still flagged active. Its current use is not confirmed. Source: Port Commission minutes, Feb 11, 2025 (sfport.com/media/10214/download); Port Commission Item 11A memo, June 5, 2026; DataSF Parcels - Active and Retired (acdm-wktn), https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json?block_num=8719A.

item.title: Correction · Terry A Francois Boulevard paseo: The map notes said the paseo is an interim roadway…
item.description: The map notes said the paseo is an interim roadway today, that satellite imagery shows the paved road to the Pier 48 gate, and that every vertex is a recorded lot corner. No imagery source was cited for the first two, so they are removed or marked unverified; the notes now quote the Design Controls (the boulevard 'will become a paseo'). The vertex claim is corrected: three of four vertices are recorded DataSF lot corners and the south-east one is on an extended line. The claim that the first two paseos were built with Phase 1 now cites the Port's Feb 2025 minutes and June 2026 report, and the lot facts cite DataSF. The Jan 30, 2018 Design Controls approval milestone and its change entry now cite the Sep 2019 Port memo that states the date. Source: Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Design Controls, 2018-04-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2025-02-11 (https://sfport.com/media/10214/download); Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Phase 2 update (Port Commission Item 11A), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf).

item.title: Planned · Terry A Francois Boulevard paseo: Port Commission approves the Mission… (Jan 30, 2018)
item.description: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design Controls, which name this planned paseo at the Terry A Francois Boulevard / Pier 48 entry (Design Controls Section 4.3); the Port's Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested this approval under Resolution 18-04, and its Sep 2019 memo dates the Commission's approvals January 30, 2018 (it numbers the Design Controls resolution 18-05) (Jan 30, 2018). Source: Port Commission Item 11A staff report, Jan 26 2018 (request); Port Commission Item 7A memo, Sep 20 2019 (approval date).
